There are no established treatment options for patients with meningioma 
recurring after surgery and radiotherapy. Somatostatin receptor type 2 (SSTR2) 
is highly expressed in meningiomas, and SSTR2-targeting radionuclide therapy 
with [177Lu]Lu-DOTATATE has shown potential activity in the treatment of 
meningioma in uncontrolled and small studies. Methods: EORTC-2334-BTG (LUMEN-1, 
NCT06326190)
